# **How Swipe helped Murthy & Kanth modernise their CA practice**


**Pradyumna Teja K. from Murthy & Kanth** shares how Swipe helped the chartered accountancy practice simplify billing, automate routine tasks, streamline GST-related workflows, and improve efficiency in its day-to-day operations.


Murthy & Kanth is a chartered accountancy practice established in 1984. Over the years, the firm has witnessed major changes in finance, taxation, compliance, and the way accounting practices operate.


As these processes became increasingly digital, the team realised that relying heavily on manual workflows was no longer practical. Automation had become an important part of running a modern and efficient CA practice.


## **Why Murthy & Kanth chose automation**


For accountants managing client records, billing, GST-related work, tax documents, and routine accounting activities, even small repetitive tasks can consume a significant amount of time.


Murthy & Kanth needed a digital solution that could reduce paperwork and make everyday billing and accounting processes easier to manage.


While searching for a suitable platform, the team discovered Swipe.


After using the software regularly for a few months, Swipe became a useful part of the firm’s daily workflow.


## **What Murthy & Kanth liked about Swipe**


For a chartered accountancy firm, managing time, maintaining accuracy, organising client information, and handling multiple accounting processes efficiently are important priorities.


According to Pradyumna Teja K., Swipe helped the firm improve several of these areas.


- Automation reduced the time spent on repetitive tasks that were previously handled manually.
- GST-related workflows became easier to manage with organised billing and transaction information.
- Billing, client records, and other routine processes could be managed more efficiently from one platform.
- The simple and user-friendly interface made it easier for employees to learn and use the system.


For Murthy & Kanth, Swipe became more than just a billing tool. Its automation and GST-related features made it useful for the firm’s everyday accounting operations.


## **How Swipe improved the firm’s workflow**


Accounting software should make everyday work easier rather than add another layer of complexity.


That was one of the reasons Swipe worked well for Murthy & Kanth.


By bringing billing, client information, GST-related workflows, and other routine activities onto one platform, the firm was able to reduce its dependence on scattered processes and manual tracking.


Automation also helped reduce repetitive work and minimise the chances of manual errors.


More importantly, the time saved on routine activities gave the team more time to focus on client service and other important areas of the practice.


## **Why the firm continues to trust Swipe**


Reliability and ease of use are important considerations when choosing billing and accounting software for a CA firm.


According to Murthy & Kanth, Swipe offers a simple interface that helps the team manage regular accounting activities without making the process unnecessarily complicated.


The platform allows the firm to manage billing, automate certain routine tasks, organise client information, and handle GST-related workflows more efficiently.


The firm’s experience with Swipe also shows that an established practice can adopt new technology without completely disrupting its existing way of working.


## **A Message for fellow CAs and business owners**


One of the key takeaways from Murthy & Kanth’s experience is that firms do not need to wait until manual processes become difficult to manage before adopting automation.


According to Pradyumna Teja K.:


“Do not delay. Automate. A computer program like Swipe does not simply help save time. It changes the entire nature of your enterprise into a more effective and lively entity.”


Whether it is an established CA firm or a newly launched business, manual invoicing and disconnected accounting processes can gradually reduce productivity.


Using a digital billing solution can help reduce repetitive work, improve organisation, and make routine financial processes easier to manage.


## **Final thoughts**


Murthy & Kanth’s experience with Swipe shows how even a well-established accounting firm can benefit from adopting modern billing technology.


By automating routine billing tasks, simplifying GST-related workflows, and bringing multiple processes onto one platform, the firm was able to make its day-to-day operations more efficient.


For firms that still rely heavily on manual invoices, switch between multiple applications, or spend unnecessary time correcting routine billing errors, automation can make a meaningful difference.
